name: UK strikes & disruption
value: No national strike; Tube strikes from 26 Nov
summary: No national-scale strike found for this week; RMT London Underground driver strikes start 26 Nov
state: The BMA said on 11 Nov that consultants in England had called off the strike planned for 25–26 Nov to enter formal talks with the government. The RMT has set eight 24-hour London Underground strikes by drivers over working hours, the first from noon on 26 Nov and the rest running to 25 Feb (IanVisits, 6 Nov). Searches on 16 Nov found no national-scale strike or nationwide disruption due this week, so the signal stays Normal.
for_you: London commuters are exposed to Tube disruption from 26 Nov, with closures likely on several lines; TfL publishes travel advice before each strike day.
